businesses.business: medical device contract development and manufacturing

offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures medical device components, subassemblies and finished devices for medical device companies. Serves OEMs in cardiac, neuromodulation, orthopedic and surgical markets as an outsourced development and manufacturing partner.

primary_products.value: implantable device components; batteries; catheters; surgical instruments; electrode leads

primary_services.value: medical device design and development; contract manufacturing; testing and validation; regulatory support

customer_segment.value: B2B: medical device OEMs and original equipment manufacturers in cardiac, neuromodulation and orthopedic markets

revenue_model.value: product sales: manufactured components and finished devices sold to medical device customers; service fees: design, development, testing and regulatory services billed to customers

value_chain_position.value: component supplier: supplies components and subassemblies bought by device makers; OEM / manufacturer: builds finished devices under customer designs, sold to medical device companies; service provider: provides outsourced design, development and validation services to customers
value_chain_position.category: component supplier; OEM / manufacturer; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia, with sites including Mexico, Ireland, Germany and Malaysia

specialization.value: related lines: medical device components, batteries and contract manufacturing for device makers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales teams selling to medical device OEMs

regulatory_exposure.value: high: medical devices and FDA-registered manufacturing under FDA quality system rules and ISO 13485
